title: Translation Layer
subtitle: Combine-to-game movement signatures for NFL prospect evaluation
hypothesis: Movement mechanics observed in Combine drills can be transformed into role-specific features that have measurable relationships with regular-season movement outcomes.
The useful unit is not a single athletic score but a translation signature that preserves position, drill context, uncertainty, and comparable on-field behaviors.
candidate_outputs: bust-risk evidence framed as model signal rather than deterministic label
development recommendations tied to measurable movement deltas
truth_boundaries: No competition data has been accessed in this scaffold.
No leaderboard score, validation metric, or NFL personnel outcome is claimed.
Rules acceptance and provider entry remain human-only.
